issues.problem: Story said Zhong Rong praised the 'Nineteen Old Poems'; the 诗品 passage praises the anonymous Han 'Old Poems' (the fourteen Lu Ji imitated), not exactly the Nineteen.
issues.action: Reworded to 'the anonymous Old Poems of the Han'; rest of story and source kept.

issues.problem: Context 6 (blurting out a plan over drinks) had no success behind it, so 忘乎所以 fitted as well or better.
issues.action: Added that he had just landed a big deal, so the elation comes from success.

issues.problem: Context 1 (stepping in when someone is bullied) fitted 见义勇为, which is in the same set, equally well.
issues.action: Rewrote as speaking up for a colleague wrongly blamed by the boss, where 见义勇为 does not fit.

issues.problem: Context 1 (waiting for exam results) fitted 提心吊胆, which is in the same set, just as well; that near-synonym was not listed in near.
issues.action: Rewrote context 1 to stress not knowing whether the news is good or bad; added a near entry for 提心吊胆.
